_documentation: Golden asset fixture — one asset with known NOI timeline, exit cap, debt, and ownership. All expected values precomputed by hand for audit. If the engine produces different numbers, either the engine has drifted or this fixture has drifted — either way investigate before promoting any snapshot that depends on asset rollup math.

noi_timeline_annualized._note: NOI is net operating income per year. H1 2026 annualized to 3472500 for simplicity; H1 actual = 1736250 (exactly half).

debt_schedule._note: Simple IO loan at acquisition; principal unchanged through the hold.

ownership._note: Asset is held in a JV where the fund owns 85%.

expected_cash_flows_for_asset_irr._note: Equity perspective: investor puts in $20M at acquisition, receives net NOI after debt service each year, and receives exit proceeds net of debt at the end.
expected_cash_flows_for_asset_irr._note_irr: Engine-verified date-weighted XIRR on these flows is 22.0324% (2026-04-19, bisection solver irr_engine.xirr). Independent Newton-step solver must agree within 1bp. If either solver drifts from this value, investigate before promoting snapshots that depend on asset IRR.
